title: Skeleton: skeleton-text - animated gradient text (daisyUI)
notes:
Skeleton is a component that can be used to show a loading state of a component.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/skeleton/+page.md
